label: Gibna bayda
note: Salt is added to the milk before the rennet, as in Domiati.

about.text: A soft, white, salty Sudanese cheese pickled in brine or whey, resembling feta; made from cow, goat or sheep milk, usually at home or on small farms.

links.name: FAO, The technology of traditional milk products in developing countries, ch. 7

how.label: salt the milk
how.text: FAO: the cheese resembles feta in appearance, texture and flavour. Like Domiati, the salt goes into the milk, not onto the curd. Starter cultures are not normally used.

steps.note: With one rennet tablet in 1 L water per 100 L milk, or Solanum dubium fruit extract (25 ml per 50 L in one trial).
In a wooden frame, to about half its volume.
Held in tins of whey or brine with no culture added: the milk's own bacteria ferment it, then salt-tolerant streptococci and lactobacilli.
